statements.t: We have entered and may continue to enter into commercial arrangements to support our operations and anticipated growth, as well as the development of the broader SI infrastructure ecosystem by customers and commercial partners and expand access to our AI technologies.

Under our cloud compute capacity arrangements, we have committed, and expect to continue to commit in the future, to purchase GPU compute capacity from cloud service providers (CSPs) either to the extent it is not successfully placed with third-party customers, or for capacity we reserved and may sell or assign to third parties.

We entered into data center leases which we expect to assign or sublease to commercial partners, and provided credit support to certain commercial partners in the form of guarantees of their lease and debt obligations in the event of their default.
We expect that international sales will continue to be a significant portion of total sales in the foreseeable future.

In addition to our debt obligations, we have entered and may continue to enter into commercial arrangements to support our operations and anticipated growth as well as the development of the broader SI infrastructure ecosystem by our customers and commercial partners and expand access to our AI technologies.

As of September 26, 2026, unconditional commitments related to our operations were $48.8 billion, of which $33.4 billion is expected to be paid in the remainder of fiscal year 2026 and fiscal year 2027.

Commitments for cloud compute capacity arrangements that are intended to support the broader SI infrastructure development and expand access to our technologies were $6.2 billion, of which $1.5 billion is expected to be paid in the remainder of fiscal year 2026 and fiscal year 2027.

Future payments under data center leases not yet commenced that we expect to assign or sublease to commercial partners were $13.3 billion, and the maximum potential amount of future payments under our guarantees was $8.5 billion.
We have subleased certain of these data center leases to commercial partners and expect to receive $0.9 billion under these noncancellable subleases through 2036.
Leases for our operations that have not yet commenced are expected to commence beginning in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027.
Our equity investment commitments are subject to certain conditions and are expected to be funded through fiscal year 2028.

Commitments that are intended to support the development of the broader SI infrastructure and expanding access to our technologies consist of cloud compute capacity and data center leases not yet commenced, both of which are made available to third parties, as well as guarantees.
We expect to assign or sublease data center leases not yet commenced to commercial partners.

We expect to fund our operations, capital expenditures, commitments and strategic activities over the next 12 months and beyond through our cash, cash equivalents, short-term investments and cash flows from operations, together with borrowing capacity under our revolving credit facility and commercial paper program, which we believe will be sufficient for these needs.
